extensionDescription.message: Import rubrics for Moodle Assignments and Workshops from CSV and Excel files.

dropZoneTitle.message: Import a rubric from CSV or Excel

dropZoneText.message: or drag and drop a CSV or Excel file here

invalidFileType.message: Invalid file type. Please drop a CSV or Excel .xlsx file.

workshopInvalidCriterion.message: Criterion $CRITERION$ is not valid for Workshop. Grades must be unique integers between 0 and 100.

workshopReplaceConfirmation.message: This Workshop already contains a rubric. Replace it with the selected file contents?

workshopAutoSaveConfirmation.message: This rubric needs more levels than Moodle currently shows. MoodlIA will temporarily save the form to create the required spaces and continue the import. Continue?

workshopExpansionFailed.message: Moodle could not create the additional spaces. Review the form errors and try again.

workshopImportCompleted.message: Rubric imported. Review it and choose a save option.

optionsIntro.message: Moodle sites where the importer activates automatically. On any other Moodle, click the extension icon on the rubric page.

optionsInputHint.message: You can paste the Moodle home URL or a rubric editor URL. MoodlIA Rubrics will detect the base path automatically.

optionsPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted for that host.

popupNotRubricPage.message: Open a rubric editing page or a Workshop assessment form in Moodle, then click this icon again.

popupActivationFailed.message: The importer could not be activated on this page.

popupAlwaysHint.message: To avoid clicking the icon every time, activate it automatically on this Moodle. Chrome asks for permission for this site only.

whatsNewIntro.message: Since version 1.2.0 the extension no longer activates by itself on the Xunta Moodle sites and asks for no site permissions when installed. It now works the same on any Moodle:

whatsNewStepClick.message: On a rubric editing page or a Workshop assessment form, click the extension icon: the importer appears on that page.

whatsNewStepAlways.message: If you use it often on one Moodle, click “Always activate on this site” in the same menu. Chrome asks for permission for that site only, and from then on the importer appears by itself.

whatsNewPin.message: Tip: pin the icon to the Chrome toolbar from the extensions button (the puzzle piece) to keep it at hand.

whatsNewSites.message: Sites you had already added in the options keep working as before.
